scope: Fix the immediate Byte Buddy cartridge exit caused by recoverable Waveshare display refresh-ack timeouts

diagnosis.symptom: Byte Buddy returned before its first usable game frame on hardware while the launcher itself remained stable
diagnosis.root_cause: cartridge_present treated ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT as fatal even though the same Waveshare DPI timeout means the frame copy completed and only the later refresh acknowledgement was missed
diagnosis.correction: Count and continue only Waveshare ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT cartridge submissions; retain fail-closed behavior for every hard display error
diagnosis.regression_marker: P4_CONSOLE_OS CARTRIDGE_FRAME_ACK_MISSED app=<id> action=continue backlight_preserved=1 count=<n>

checks: Byte Buddy AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer unit suite passed
P4 Game API SDL host smoke and save-service tests passed
1200 rendered simulator frames completed without sanitizer failure
scripted touch journey covered egg care, cracking, hatching, baby, winged, flying, elemental, signal scanning, tracking, battle, and genetics
140 chronological RGB565 animation preview frames rendered successfully from the production resource payload

install.policy: application only; bootloader, partition table, OTA data, NVS, microSD, and factory backup preserved

serial_boot_evidence: P4_CONSOLE_OS GAME_CATALOG available=1 packages=12 valid=12 omitted=0
P4_CONSOLE_OS READY page=home display=mipi-dsi storage=microsd-read-only h2_role=usb-host-external-vbus
P4_CONSOLE_OS STATS loops=300 gamepad=1 gamepad_failures=0 display_timeouts=8 display_failures=0
limitations: No physical Byte Buddy launch occurred during the 120-second retained-UART listener, so CARTRIDGE_START and in-game frame recovery remain pending on-device acceptance.
Local simulation validates game code, touch routing, resources, animation progress, and sanitizers but cannot replace ESP32-P4 display-timing acceptance.
The microSD package catalog remained 12/12 valid; this repair changed Console OS rather than rewriting game files on the card.
